---
title: "What changed between PLACES 2024 and 2025"
---

Every measure for one county, both PLACES releases side by side, largest
absolute change first — run live against the real catalog.

{{< include _duckdb-shared.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof countyFips = Inputs.text({
  label: "County geo_id (5-digit FIPS)",
  value: "09170",
  placeholder: "e.g. 08031"
})
```

South Central Connecticut Planning Region (`09170`) is the default —
Connecticut's PLACES rows use 2022-vintage planning-region FIPS even though
PLACES tags them `geo_vintage=2020` (see
[Concepts › Time axes](/concepts/time-axes.qmd) and
[cancer-on-ice#21](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/21)).
Try `08031` (Denver County, CO) for an ordinary county.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sql = `SELECT o25.measure_id,
       o24.value AS v2024, o25.value AS v2025,
       round(o25.value - o24.value, 2) AS delta
FROM coi.measure.observation o24
JOIN coi.measure.observation o25
  ON o24.measure_id = o25.measure_id AND o24.geo_id = o25.geo_id
  AND o24.stratum_id = o25.stratum_id
WHERE o24.source = 'PLACES' AND o24.source_release = '2024'
  AND o25.source = 'PLACES' AND o25.source_release = '2025'
  AND o24.geo_id = 'county:${countyFips}'
  AND o24.valid_to IS NULL AND o25.valid_to IS NULL
  AND o24.value IS NOT NULL AND o25.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 15`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState = {
  sql; // reactive dependency
  if (dbState.status !== "ready") return dbState;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const result = await dbState.conn.query(sql);
    return { status: "ready", rows: rowsFromArrow(result), ms: performance.now() - t0 };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderStatus(dbState, queryState)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? (queryState.rows.length
      ? Inputs.table(queryState.rows, { columns: ["measure_id", "v2024", "v2025", "delta"] })
      : html`<p><em>No measure has a value in both releases for this county — check the FIPS code.</em></p>`)
  : html`<p><em>Table will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```
